name: Creamy Pork Chops with Pancetta-Thyme Gravy
condition_notes: 564 cal (in 400-650 band), 5g total carbs (4g net, <=35g), pork/no seafood, method scales linearly to 14 - clears all conditions. Carries wanted pricer-lane flags: pancetta and xanthan gum (no board home).
reason: No catalog collision: the pancetta + fresh-thyme + cream reduction is a distinct Italian-leaning flavor with no equivalent among the pork-chop set. Nearest neighbors are different plates - creamy-mushroom-pork-chops (mushroom, not pancetta/thyme; over mashed potato), countryfried-pork-chops-with-bacon-gravy (breaded/fried with a Southern milk-flour white gravy, not a cream reduction), and southern-smothered (onion cream). Pancetta-thyme cream distinguishes it on the sauce axis.
cross_protein_collision_notes: Watch for a creamy chicken with pancetta/bacon + thyme cream sauce (Marry-Me-style or 'creamy bacon thyme chicken') in the chicken pool, or a creamy-thyme turkey cutlet - same pancetta/cured-pork + thyme-cream gravy structure with the protein swapped. Also note pool-adjacent to candidate creamy-smothered-onion-pork-chops-skillet (both creamy skillet pork chops, no starch), but the flavor drivers differ (onion-cream vs pancetta-thyme) so not a pool-dupe; that sibling is separately ruled DUPE against the catalog.
